description:
The best way to draw with ChatGPT!

Draw whatever you want, then talk to ChatGPT about it!

e.g.

- "Let me draw a diagram so I can explain with @Amazing Drawing"
- "I want to sketch a logo with @Amazing Drawing, then you generate a finished image from it"
- "Let's play a game with @Amazing Drawing. Guess what I draw."
- "I want to use @Amazing Drawing to show you my planned layout, and you can tell me what you think."
- "@Amazing Drawing, analyze this sketch."
